doc.brief: Predefined values for use as response ids in gtk_dialog_add_button().
doc.md:
Predefined values for use as response ids in gtk_dialog_add_button().

All predefined values are negative; GTK leaves values of 0 or greater for
application-defined response ids.

accept.brief: Generic response id, not used by GTK dialogs
accept.md: Generic response id, not used by GTK dialogs

apply.md: Returned by Apply buttons in GTK dialogs
